mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (refresh_token_id, erp_account_id, token) VALUES (#{refreshTokenId}, #{erpAccountId}, #{token})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM refresh_token WHERE erp_account_id = #{erpAccountId} AND refresh_token_id NOT IN (SELECT refresh_token_id FROM refresh_token WHERE erp_account_id = #{erpAccountId} ORDER BY refresh_token_id DESC FETCH FIRST #{keep} ROWS ONLY)
